description: Representative shared status badge mappings across AnchorKit domains (issue #198).

severity.label: Confirmed
severity.headline: Transaction confirmed
severity.detail: The transaction completed successfully on the Stellar network.

severity.label: Awaiting You
severity.headline: Action required
severity.detail: Please complete the required steps before the anchor can proceed.

severity.label: Blocked
severity.headline: Cannot proceed
severity.detail: One or more validation errors must be resolved before the transaction can be submitted.

severity.label: Unavailable
severity.headline: Check unavailable
severity.detail: This readiness stage could not be evaluated.

severity.label: Checking
severity.headline: Checking…
severity.detail: Validating your input. This should only take a moment.

severity.label: Unfunded
severity.headline: Account not funded
severity.detail: The account exists but has no balance. Fund it via Friendbot to send transactions.

severity.label: Invalid
severity.headline: Invalid public key
severity.detail: The value is not a structurally valid Stellar public key.

severity.label: Disputed
severity.headline: Milestone disputed
severity.detail: This milestone has been disputed and requires resolution before further progress.
